tools.name: dnsimple_whoami
tools.description: Identify the authenticated account/user for the current API token. Use this to discover your account id (data.account.id). API: GET /whoami.

tools.name: dnsimple_list_domains
tools.description: List the domains in the account, with pagination and optional filters. API: GET /{account}/domains.

tools.name: dnsimple_get_domain
tools.description: Retrieve a single domain by name or id. API: GET /{account}/domains/{domain}.

tools.name: dnsimple_list_zone_records
tools.description: List the DNS records in a zone, with pagination and optional filters. API: GET /{account}/zones/{zone}/records.

tools.name: dnsimple_get_zone_record
tools.description: Retrieve a single DNS record in a zone by its numeric id. API: GET /{account}/zones/{zone}/records/{record}.

tools.name: dnsimple_check_domain
tools.description: Check whether a domain is available to register. Returns { domain, available, premium }. API: GET /{account}/registrar/domains/{domain}/check.

tools.name: dnsimple_get_domain_prices
tools.description: Retrieve the registration, renewal, and transfer prices for a domain. API: GET /{account}/registrar/domains/{domain}/prices.

tools.name: dnsimple_list_zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones in the account, with pagination and optional filters. API: GET /{account}/zones.

tools.name: dnsimple_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts in the account (used as domain registrants). API: GET /{account}/contacts.

tools.name: dnsimple_create_zone_record
tools.description: Create a new DNS record in a zone. Additive — it adds a record without touching existing ones. API: POST /{account}/zones/{zone}/records.

tools.name: dnsimple_update_zone_record
tools.description: Update an existing DNS record. WARNING: mutates LIVE DNS — changing content/ttl takes effect for real resolution. Only the fields you provide are sent. API: PATCH /{account}/zones/{zone}/records/{record}.

tools.name: dnsimple_delete_zone_record
tools.description: Delete a DNS record from a zone. WARNING: permanently removes a live DNS record. API: DELETE /{account}/zones/{zone}/records/{record}. Returns 204 (no body).
